_comment: thgem_sink generic event definition (--event-def / TOML event_def_file, TODO 88) for 11B_208Pb. Modules = config/channel_map_11B_208Pb.txt, FINAL cabling (user, 2026-11-20): 0 VX2730 (ch0 beam/100, ch1-7 Gamma1-6 + Gamma0, ch8-31 Neutron Wall NWB12-01 + NWA12-01), 1-3 ThGEM boards (D1-D8: T on ch0/5/10 of modules 1 and 2, ch0/5 of module 3), 4 Si beam monitors. The trigger channels below are the map's T lines; thgem_sink warns at start-up and at every run start when the two disagree.

Trigger = any ThGEM trigger D1-D8 (TODO 88). The l2 flag pair marks events with two or more ThGEM triggers (flag only: every event is written; the calibration wants the single-ThGEM events, user 2026-11-20).

Window: pre 500, post 1500 ns around the reference trigger, as on N_Wall (user, 2026-11-17: fine, maybe shorter would do). The delay-line arms come ~+20..+260 ns after their own trigger (October); a second ThGEM trigger can sit up to group_ns from the reference, so its arms stay inside post. The Neutron Wall neutrons come AFTER the reaction (1500 ns covers 0.1 MeV at 2 m). group_ns 100: triggers of one reaction form one event.
Times are on the ALIGNED axis (time_calib_file is applied first). thgem_sink re-reads this file at every run start: write a temp file and mv it into place.
